title: GTN Appoints Mark Jennings to Lead Tokenized Securities Strategy
description: GTN named former Gemini Europe chief Mark Jennings as global head of digital assets on November 10, tasking him with tokenized securities strategy across its existing multi-market brokerage infrastructure.
why_it_matters: The appointment places tokenization leadership inside a brokerage technology provider already serving banks and investment platforms. GTN's existing market connectivity could help partners explore on-chain securities, but the announcement does not establish a live tokenized-stock product or a confirmed launch timetable.
keyTakeaways: Mark Jennings was appointed GTN's global head of digital assets on November 10, 2026.
He previously led Gemini Europe and held senior positions at Kraken, including Crypto Facilities.
GTN says its brokerage infrastructure spans more than 90 markets and up to eight asset classes.
The company describes a tokenization strategy, not the launch of a new tokenized securities venue.
body:
GTN appointed Mark Jennings as its global head of digital assets on November 10, 2026, putting a former Gemini Europe executive in charge of the brokerage infrastructure provider's tokenized securities strategy. The Dubai-based company said Jennings will work on enabling platforms to connect traditional securities markets with digital-asset services through GTN's existing market access.

Jennings previously served as CEO of Gemini Europe, overseeing the exchange's expansion in the region. Earlier, he held senior roles at Kraken, including leadership of Crypto Facilities, the firm's UK-regulated derivatives venue. GTN also highlighted its October appointment of former Saxo Bank executive Daniel Endler as group chief product officer.

GTN describes its current brokerage infrastructure as covering more than 90 markets and up to eight asset classes through a single API. Those figures describe the company's existing capabilities, not tokenized assets already available for trading. The November announcement concerns management and strategic direction; it does not specify a launch date, a new securities product, or completed on-chain settlement.

facts.claim: GTN announced Mark Jennings as global head of digital assets on November 10, 2026.
Jennings previously served as the chief executive of Gemini Europe, leading regional expansion.
His earlier Kraken positions included chief executive of the regulated Crypto Facilities derivatives venue.
GTN appointed Daniel Endler as its first group chief product officer in October.
GTN says its existing brokerage coverage extends across more than 90 markets and eight asset classes.
facts.anchor: 90+ markets and up to 8 asset classes
